title: Paper Towel Holder (Wall Mounted), 15.5-Inch, Powder Coated Iron - Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop losing counter space to a bulky stand—mount your paper towels on the wall and keep them right where you prep and clean. This Pipeline collection paper towel holder brings an authentic pipe-style accessories look to industrial and loft-inspired kitchens while coordinating with matching Pipeline pieces.

  • Clear the counter: Wall-mounted design keeps paper towels accessible without taking up workspace.
